name: L&T Finance Ltd
title: L&T Finance Ltd - 533519 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Retail NBFC with supply-side discipline in credit: Cyclops underwriting, prime mix at 90%+ in two-wheeler, and credit cost guided down to 2–2.2% by Q4FY27, but ECL Stage 1 provisioning raised to 80bps.

triggers.label: Credit cost 2.64%, down 19bps QoQ
triggers.quote: credit costs moderated to 2.64%, a 19-basis points reduction from the previous quarter

triggers.label: Credit cost to 2–2.2% by Q4FY27
triggers.quote: credit costs should trend lower in the range of 2% to 2.2% by Q4FY27

triggers.label: Stage 1 provision cover 0.52% → 0.80%
triggers.quote: enhanced the overall PCR from 0.52% to 0.80%

triggers.label: Q4 retail disbursements ₹24,107 Cr, up 62%
triggers.quote: highest-ever quarterly retail disbursements of ₹24,107 Cr, up 62% YoY

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 20%+
triggers.quote: AUM growth of over 20% supported by robust consumer demand

guidance.quote: AUM growth of over 20% supported by robust consumer demand
We expect our NIMs +Fees to remain stable in our guided range of 10% to 10 .5%
credit costs should trend lower in the range of 2% to 2.2% by Q4FY27
by the last quarter of FY27, we are targeting to achieve a RoA of at least 2.8%
We will endeavor to drive Credit Costs down to a level of 2% or less
We will target to reach a Return on Assets in the range of 3.0% to 3.2%
We will strive to deliver a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 18%
We will attempt a Book growth CAGR of 20%+ over the Lakshya period
the opex to book range, I think we are looking at a range of 3.75% to 4% range

red_flags.label: ECL overlays shifted into Stage 1; Stage 3 PCR 73%→68%
red_flags.quote: the PCR on Stage 3 asset comes down from 73% to 68%

red_flags.label: Slippages ~₹402 Cr may be flattered by technical write-offs and collections netting
red_flags.quote: we may write off in the books, it's a technical write-off

red_flags.label: Security receipt drag ~₹4,800 Cr earning no interest
red_flags.quote: the ₹4,800 Cr does not give me any interest income

evasions.quote: we don't give business -wise credit cost estimates, we don't give out because, you know, this is like too dependent on market conditions
